title: A Necessity for Travelers!
body: This app has everything!! I travel often and have always struggled to keep all my flight information organized without digging through old emails. In this app everything is in one convenient place. It tracks flight times, total flights, distance traveled, and so much more. My favorite feature is the turbulence forecast, which is especially helpful for anyone with a fear of flying. The app is incredibly easy to use, and I genuinely haven’t seen anything quite like it. Highly recommend for anyone who loves to travel!
